bullets.text: Windows on Arm Ecosystem Expands - **Microsoft** and **NVIDIA** launch powerful Arm-based PCs, boosting app development and customer demand.
Azure SQL Foundations Launched - A new video series guides developers through modernization and AI integration in databases.
Rethinking Cybersecurity Strategies - The patch window is collapsing, necessitating a new approach to vulnerability management.
Azure SRE Agent Trial Available - New customers can explore Azure SRE Agent with a 30-day trial and no setup charges.
WebView2 Release Cadence Accelerated - **Microsoft Edge** transitions to a two-week release cycle for faster updates and security fixes.
Windows 365 Celebrates Five Years - **Microsoft** reflects on the success and evolution of Cloud PCs in enabling flexible workspaces.
Microsoft Recognized as Leader - **Microsoft** earns top spots in both **Gartner** and **IDC** reports for Desktop as a Service.
Frost Radar Recognition Achieved - **Microsoft** is named a leader in Cloud Workload Protection Platforms for unified security.
